---
title: "Hello, MathJax"
date: 2026-06-20
categories: [math, meta]
description: "A first post showing LaTeX math rendering."
---

This site renders LaTeX math through MathJax. Inline math like $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$
sits in the flow of a sentence, and display math stands on its own line:

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}.
$$

Equations can be labelled and referenced. Equation @eq-quadratic gives the roots
of $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$:

$$
x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}
$$ {#eq-quadratic}

Use the search box in the navbar to find posts, and the category links to filter
them by tag.
